$Comment: The chain's last rung, a long shift: four hundred Sawmill cycles and Woodcutting level
twenty-five, both on Order 1 so they progress together. Flow.HideLockedSteps keeps the walk
back to Marn off the step list until that shift is behind the player, so the quest reads as the
long_shifts is WORK_STATION on the station id; reach_the_level is STAT_THRESHOLD, which reads a
native stat channel by id (MMO_Level_WOODCUTTING) and holds the high-water reading, so a level
already reached counts the moment the quest is taken. No hand-in: TurnInId 'giver' still
settles it at Marn. Rewards sit in Claim: XP, one concentrated essence, and the Woodcutter's
Novice Cap, the graduation piece: a small head piece on plain wooden-helm art that carries a
first taste of the Woodcutting bonuses the woodcutter's kit is built around, so the chase for
the kit's four leather pieces (paid only by Trim Work, the order this quest opens) is legible
before it starts. Claiming this quest also opens Marn's Edge, the questline that pays his own
hatchet. Completing it is what the Master Sawyer achievement counts, so a retune here changes
Name: A_Finer_Edge
